_comment: Entry to add to modelcontextprotocol/servers upstream. Upstream has historically used a bulleted README list (Community Servers section) but has been restructured repeatedly in 2025-2026. Pick the variant that matches the CURRENT state of main before editing. All three formats below are semantically equivalent: Wael only commits ONE of them to the upstream repo.
variant_a_readme_bullet: - **[Blockchain Academics](https://github.com/blockchainacademics/bca-mcp)** - Canonical crypto MCP: 105 tools across news, entities, academy lessons, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed research generation. Hybrid `attribution.citations[]` puts the primary source first (the real upstream URL such as the original article, CoinGecko, Etherscan or the SEC), with the BCA editorial link where the site has a page for the data. Zero-config demo on first run (17 tools, no API key needed): `npx -y @blockchainacademics/mcp`
variant_b_readme_table_row: | [Blockchain Academics](https://github.com/blockchainacademics/bca-mcp) | `@blockchainacademics/mcp` | Canonical crypto MCP: 105 tools spanning news, entities, academy, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed generation. Hybrid citations: the real upstream URL first, the BCA editorial link where the site has a page. |

variant_c_manifest_entry.name: Blockchain Academics
variant_c_manifest_entry.description: Canonical crypto MCP: 105 tools spanning news, entities, academy, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed generation. Wraps api.blockchainacademics.com with an `attribution.citations[]` envelope on every response (citations[0] is the primary source: the real upstream URL when there is one, then the BCA editorial link where the site has a page).
highlights: Zero-config first run: `npx -y @blockchainacademics/mcp` works without any API key. The package ships with a public demo key that opens 17 tools (price, market overview, trending, fear and greed, sentiment, news search, article full text, as-of snapshot, entity by slug, explainer, academy search, recent stories, topic, grants search and detail, jobs list and detail), under a shared cap of 100 calls a day plus 20 a day per IP.

105 tools across 19 categories (news, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, agent-backed generation, directories, fundamentals, chain-specific, microstructure, narrative, regulatory, security, memes, compute/AI, services, history, corpus meta, memos/theses/social/currencies)

Hybrid `attribution.citations[]` envelope: citations[0] is the primary source, the real upstream URL (the original article, CoinGecko, Etherscan, SEC, DefiLlama, ...) when there is one; a BCA editorial link follows where the site has a page for the data. LLMs get true provenance first.

Honest `meta.status` enum on every response (complete | unseeded | partial | stale): vendor-degraded, stale and not-yet-ingested data are explicitly flagged with structured `meta.diagnostic` rather than masked as empty arrays. `meta.tier` and `meta.upgrade_url` carry tier hints back to agents.

92 of the 105 tools were called live against the production API on 2026-10-31 and again after the fixes on 2026-11-01, with zero crashes. Tools that write records or run paid compute were not called live.
Security hardening (H-1 + H-2 + H-3 + MCP-TS-2): BCA_API_BASE allowlist, prompt-injection fencing on tool data, webhook SSRF guard, redirect rejection.

decision_notes: If upstream README.md on main uses a plain bulleted list under 'Community Servers', use variant_a_readme_bullet.
If upstream switched to a markdown table with columns (Server | Package | Description), use variant_b_readme_table_row.

If upstream migrated to a JSON/YAML manifest (e.g. community-servers.json) for programmatic listing, adapt variant_c_manifest_entry to the current schema. The fields in variant_c are a superset: prune to match.
In all cases: keep the diff to a single file and a minimal addition (1 line for README variants; 1 entry for manifest variants). Reviewers reject mega-diffs.
